facts.fact: The Citizen reports the Universal Communications Service Access Fund signed a five-year MoU with the Tanzania Agricultural Research Institute on 24 November 2026 to support internet connectivity across its 21 research centres and 25 sub-centres so research reaches rural farmers; no sites connected are stated.

TZA.note: A UCSAF-TARI memorandum is described with no amount, budget line or statement of domestic financing.
The agricultural research institute is not described as researching digital policy.
